scope: Candidate public web, actual original PNG inspection; no source, browser or device operations

findings: Chromium and WebKit desktop activity/reopened views show the activity title, complete long location, candidate date range and a separate smaller grey dot/status/full Europe/Berlin caption. No status capsule or action outline is visible.
390px Chinese submitted views show 收集空闲 · Europe/Berlin below the date. Activity-anonymous views correctly show 选择活动 · Europe/Berlin instead. Long title/location wrap within the page width.
320px/20px dark anonymous views show the complete title, wrapped location/date and complete grey Collecting availability · Europe/Berlin line without horizontal clipping.
390px invitation views show both dates with separate 23:00–24:00 and 00:00–01:00 highlighted spans, final-time legend and distinct ignore/accept/decline actions. No collection caption remains.
390px published views show Plan confirmed/计划已确定, accepted/final-sent messaging, 2/4 confirmed and separate pending versus declined roster states.

320px dark reply views clearly show Reply later and Reply to invitation while the invitation remains pending. The first date/highlight is visible; the second date begins below the internal timetable viewport.
Desktop FIXED activity views retain explicit cross-day fixed time, complete timezone, Activity undecided/Suggest an activity and a read-only highlighted timetable, without collection metadata.
limitations: Both narrow-large-dark-joined full-page captures contain the fixed bottom submission bar over the initial viewport region that includes the metadata status. These two images do not independently demonstrate that joined-state status is visibly readable after scrolling. This is not enough evidence to classify an inaccessible or clipped product element; a targeted scrolled viewport capture is recommended before declaring full narrow-state visual acceptance.
The narrow reply images do not expose the second day highlight inside the independently scrollable invitation timetable. Both day highlights are visibly confirmed in the 390px and desktop images.

This partition contains no standalone desktop decline-action screenshot; the published mobile roster visibly distinguishes pending and declined. API semantics, exact calendar endpoints, uniqueness, cleanup and actual action completion are separate automated evidence, not inferred solely from PNGs.

Reviewed only these 20 candidate images, not production, phone UI or other partitions. Full-page screenshots show fixed bars over one viewport position; simultaneous visibility of every page element is not claimed.
visualEvidenceFollowUp: Capture narrow joined/submitted metadata in a scrolled viewport above the fixed save bar before full visual acceptance.
